postconditions.description: If searchText is empty, the output must be 0.

postconditions.expression: stdout == fullText.count(searchText) if not allowOverlap else True
postconditions.description: If allowOverlap is False, the output must be the count of non-overlapping occurrences of searchText in fullText.

postconditions.expression: stdout == sum(1 for i in range(len(fullText) - len(searchText) + 1) if fullText[i:i+len(searchText)] == searchText) if allowOverlap else True
postconditions.description: If allowOverlap is True, the output must be the count of overlapping occurrences of searchText in fullText.
